arStrings.szText: The reapers have returned. This is only the beginning.

I defeated the reaper Seraziel, but I doubt she is the last of them. What's more, as her soul leaked away, she gave a warning. "He is coming." Who? Malthael? Or someone else? Whatever the case, death is coming to Sanctuary. I must warn everyone.
